segments.sensitive: One reviewer with extremely sensitive skin reports the foam soothes and tones without irritation.
segments.mature: Two reviewers with visibly aging or grey-bearded skin credit it with keeping skin looking younger or ageless.

concerns.redness: Reviewers describe it calming skin irritated by shaving, cooling and soothing razor bumps and nape/ear irritation without a burning or stinging sensation.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers state it tightens pores and cleans without leaving skin feeling greasy or oily; no dissent reported.
concerns.aging: Two reviewers say it makes skin look younger or keeps their age less visible, though this is a small, anecdotal minority of comments.

aspects.libelle: Foams unexpectedly well for a non-aerosol
Runny liquid texture, hard to apply without spilling

extraits.texte: Smells good, feels nice and clean, but very runny. It turns into a liquid as soon as you squirt it onto your hands. Then it's hard to splash it on your face without losing any. If it was slightly thicker like a gel or foamy like shaving cream, it would be perfect.

extraits.titre: AMAZING! You need this in your shaving kit!
extraits.texte: I'll admit I was skeptical at first, but this foam is great! Makes your skin feel great after a shave and closes up your pores without making your skin oily or giving you a burning sensation. The foam keeps your skin soft all day long after a morning shave! Now they just need to make a travel size version!

I switched my regular toner to this and now it's a product I cannot live without. Works fantastic and keeps your skin looking great and people will never know your age. Unless your beard is mostly grey like mine. But it's definitely a go to.

Love this product for my scalp and neck line which can get easily irritated from shaving. I apply after shave immediately after shaving and will use this astringent foam between shaves to keep my pores tight.
This is the best "aftershave" I have found. It works amazingly on my extremely sensitive skin, helping to soothe and tone the skin. Recommend this product to everyone!
Helps me keep the razor bumps away when other aftershaves weren't doing the trick. Light on the skin without the sting. Smells good too!
Feels amazing on my skin and doesn't make my face feel all oily

reserve: This is a shaving astringent foam rather than a facial skincare product, so most reviews describe post-shave skin feel rather than skin type or ongoing skin concerns in the app's usual sense.
